source_snapshot.items: Out-of-band firmware upgrade/downgrade and recovery for HMC and FPGA
source_snapshot.procedure: One generic DGX bundle upload to HGX_0.

old_problem: HMC and FPGA targets, separate-versus-atomic images, direction/order, activation and independent recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: Whether one bundle safely updates two firmware classes is core OEM command/recovery meaning; ED-07/12 prohibit guessing or cross-crediting their directions.
decision_basis: Preserved HMC and FPGA as separate identities and both directions.

test_case.test_name: OOB HMC and FPGA firmware directional matrix
test_case.purpose: Update HMC and FPGA with component-correct direction-specific artifacts and independent version/recovery evidence.
required_package: HMC controller/bank and FPGA device map
test_case.test_command: Do not use one generic task until approved. Execute one signed component/direction step at a time or the explicitly atomic bundle, preserving pre/task/post versions and component health.
test_case.expected_result: Each selected component reaches its exact target version in approved order and both components/platform remain recoverable and healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: One generic bundle/version cannot prove HMC and FPGA or both directions.
test_case.recovery: Invoke the failing component's approved recovery; do not continue to the other component automatically.

source_conflict.reason: One HGX bundle conflates HMC/FPGA targets, images and directions.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Decide bundle semantics and supply component maps/images/directions/order/recovery.

project_authority: HMC/FPGA bundle and recovery semantics are OEM-specific.
